rv.q: A Play, a Pie and a Pint’s strong run of productions ends with an awkward and overstuffed eco-drama written by Jennifer Adam and directed by Catriona MacLeod

She has named the gift Ivor; though it’s not a puppy, but a twenty-foot iceberg recently calved on the coast of Greenland, near where Scarlet’s late father was born. Scarlet arrives, and is a tad underwhelmed by her gift, which is clearly impossible to transport.

The result in Catriona MacLeod’s archly pitched production is a thoughtful but still entertaining hour that scratches the surface of current global concerns to get to the human drive behind those who stand in opposition.
